answer.reason: The verses state one deed of Jair: he took the towns and country of Argob and named them after himself.

clauses.english: took the country of Argob and called it after his own name
clauses.quote: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob

doubts: NUM 32:41 describes Jair taking small towns of Gilead; the same deed is told in DEU 3:14, so only one clause is written.
JOS 13:30, 1KI 4:13 and 1CH 2:22-23 only mention the towns of Jair or his cities and add nothing more about him; 1CH 2:22 may concern a different Jair, a descendant through Segub.
